answer_1.quote: We generate natural language descriptions enabling humans to intuitively understand the semantic meaning of each latent concept. Specifically, for each latent concept ... we collect MSMARCO passages that most activate the corresponding latent concept and instruct a LLM to summarize the common themes...
answer_1.outputs: Natural language descriptions of latent concepts

answer_4.quote: We instructed 6 graduate students in machine learning (not authors of this paper) to identify the target passage based on the provided descriptions and activation strength.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to identify the target passage from a set of distractors using latent concept descriptions and activation strengths, and to choose which of two passages the DPR model would rank higher.
